correctness.rationale: For g_i>0, |j|<min g_i, direct symbolic characteristic-polynomial expansion yields z[z²+2Gz+3(H+j²)]. Double-root Jordan behavior follows from restriction to the sum-zero invariant plane and the unique scalar restriction at g_0=g_1=g_2,j=0. Flux conservation gives J=2j/3 and EPR sigma=(2j/3)sum log((g_i+j)/(g_i-j)). Strict convexity of the log-ratio in g_i establishes the entropy-minimum uniform ring and equality; monotonicity of the budget equation yields its unique root and exact global frequency upper bound. The extracted checker gave 2,274 passing assertions including symbolic identity and example Jordan rank. Proof covers all strict positive parameter ranges, not just finite tests.

value.rationale: A three-state ring is a natural minimal nonequilibrium oscillator and an experimentally relevant motif in dephased-walk studies. A necessary-and-sufficient disorder feasibility barrier is not a superficial parameter substitution: it shows (g_0,g_1,g_2)=(1,1,3) cannot oscillate despite arbitrarily large dissipation. The sharp, globally attained EPR-frequency frontier at fixed aggregate kinetic scale identifies an equality-rigid design rule and quantitatively separates mere detailed-balance breaking from relaxation oscillations. The statement has a full natural classification at minimal ring size with an interpretable physical cost.
